title: types/<type>/pack.mjs default export, contract v0
description: Phase 1 contract v0 (MASTER-PLAN 3.2, D-28): { id, pages(ctx, common), styles.partials, mandatory.pageLints, checks.builds } plus the members below. Validate projectPack(pack) from engine/lib/pack.mjs, in which every function is the string "function". engine/lib/pack.mjs packProblems() applies the same rules at build time. Members of the full contract (routes, content, chrome objects, media, games, client, jsonld, budgets, csp, permissions, offline, probes, policyUrls, ppc, lanes, approvalItems, uniqueness, judgeRubric) are added in Phase 2 and later; unknown members are allowed until then so packs can grow ahead of the schema.

id.description: Equals the directory name under types/.

status.description: stub: the engine adds lint type-stub (warning; error under --strict).

chrome.description: Phase 1: which chrome engine/lib/layout.mjs draws (default full).

pages.description: pages(ctx, common) -> page objects in sitemap order; common = the engine's { about, terms, privacy, cookies, contact, notFound, offline }.

policy.description: An id in the pack's policy-urls.json (Phase 2: demotes the rule to warn while unverified).
